ARQAAM EGYPT

Important Warning – Fraudulent Scams and Impersonation Alert: Arqaam Group has become aware of fraudulent individuals and entities falsely claiming to be affiliated with Arqaam, its subsidiaries, or employees. These impersonators may attempt to solicit investments or personal information through unofficial channels, including WhatsApp, social media, or unverified websites. Please be advised of the following: Arqaam never solicits investments or payments via WhatsApp, social media platforms, or unverified online links. Always verify email addresses and phone numbers against those officially listed on the Arqaam Group website. NEVER transfer funds or share personal information unless you have confirmed the identity of the Arqaam representative through official channels. If you suspect fraudulent activity or have been contacted by someone claiming to represent Arqaam through unofficial means, please report it immediately via our official website or call our authorised contact numbers. Stay vigilant. Protect yourself from fraud. Arqaam accepts no responsibility for losses resulting from dealings with unauthorised persons.
